title: Jagged Savory Kenyan Beef Stew
description: A hearty and energizing Kenyan dish featuring ground cardamom and kombu-cold-extract, with a salty and cheese-pull flavor profile. This high-protein-friendly stew is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the ground cardamom and cook for 1 minute.
Add the kombu-cold-extract, beef broth, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the shredded cheddar cheese until it is melted and the stew is heated through.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
